metadata.roster_definition: Players with ACT or INA status in at least one 2025 regular-season weekly roster. Includes later injured, released and traded players; not a single-date 53-man roster.
metadata.contract_units: Source Parquet amounts are millions of USD; stored amounts are USD.
metadata.featured_definition: Largest reported total contract values among matched contracts signed in 2025; signing dates within the year are not supplied.
